_readme: Tập gieo tay của #7 — 20 claim phóng đại và 12 claim sạch làm đối chứng.
Claim cố ý viết theo lối một tác giả thật sẽ viết, KHÔNG chép lại từ điển ở
src/judge/overclaim/overclaim-lexicon.ts. Nếu chép, tỉ lệ bắt được luôn là 100% và con số
mất hết ý nghĩa. Có claim tầng luật bắt trượt là chuyện bình thường — chỗ đó là vùng xám
của tầng LLM, và tỉ lệ trượt phải được báo nguyên trong docs/evaluation_report.md.

experiments.title: Retrieval quality on Vietnamese legal QA
bullets: Evaluate on the ZaloLegal corpus of 3000 statute passages

single_domain.baselines_and_metrics: BM25 baseline; nDCG@10 and recall@50 as metrics.
single_domain.ablation_plan: Remove the reranker stage and re-measure nDCG@10.
single_domain.risks_and_limitations: Only one corpus is available with gold relevance labels.

experiments.title: Qualitative inspection of generated answers
bullets: Read 50 generated answers on the ZaloLegal corpus
Note cases where the answer cites a statute that does not exist

no_baseline.baselines_and_metrics: We inspect outputs manually and describe what we observe.
no_baseline.risks_and_limitations: No quantitative comparison is planned yet.

experiments.title: Retrieval on legal text
bullets: Compare against a BM25 baseline, report nDCG@10

experiments.title: Retrieval on medical text
bullets: Compare against the same BM25 baseline, report nDCG@10

two_domain.baselines_and_metrics: BM25 baseline on both the ZaloLegal and ViMedQA datasets; nDCG@10.
two_domain.ablation_plan: Drop the reranker on each domain separately.
two_domain.risks_and_limitations: Two domains is still narrow for a generality claim.

claims.text: Our retrieval pipeline improves answer accuracy across all domains.
The reranker is domain-agnostic and needs no per-corpus tuning.
The method works for any language with a subword tokenizer.
Retrieval quality improves regardless of document formatting.
Our approach always returns the governing statute in the top ten results.
The system is universally applicable to legal question answering.
We evaluate across three domains and observe consistent gains.
The technique transfers to five datasets without any modification.
Our reranker outperforms all published baselines for legal retrieval.
The pipeline is model-agnostic and accepts arbitrary encoders.
Performance is superior to prior work in all settings we considered.
The retriever never fails to surface the relevant article.
Our method significantly reduces hallucinated statute citations.
The approach dramatically improves end-to-end answer latency.
Answer quality is substantially better than the retrieval-free setting.
This chunking strategy generalizes across languages and scripts.
The result is broadly applicable to retrieval-augmented generation.
Our system consistently outperforms dense retrieval on legal corpora.
The method generalizes to every professional domain we might encounter.
Hybrid retrieval achieves state-of-the-art results on legal question answering.
Hybrid retrieval improves nDCG@10 over BM25 on the ZaloLegal corpus.
The reranker raises recall@50 on Vietnamese statute passages.
Removing the reranker lowers nDCG@10 on the ZaloLegal corpus.
Our pipeline answers statute lookup questions using retrieved passages.
The reranker improves nDCG@10 on both the ZaloLegal and ViMedQA datasets.
We compare hybrid retrieval against BM25 on two Vietnamese corpora.
Retrieval latency stays under 400 ms per query on a single RTX 3090.
We inspect fifty generated answers and catalogue the citation errors we find.
The chunking size of 512 tokens gives higher recall@50 than 256 tokens here.
Gold relevance labels exist for 3000 passages in the ZaloLegal corpus.
The same BM25 baseline is used in both experiments for comparability.
We report nDCG@10 and recall@50 for every configuration we train.
